comments: 34e0ba1f: This block is the main routine for entering IRT (Incomplete Records Tracking) deficiencies.

fe03e338: Ensure the event date is after the admission date; if not, warn the user and reprompt.
78b821e5: Check that the event date is not after the discharge date; if it is, warn the user and reprompt.
ead107c3: If the type is an inpatient, set the default date for the last movement.
